- Bottom region: Purple on rows 34-38, white on rows 39-43 (unchanged)

1. Top region: White (click on white)
2. Bottom region: All purple (need to stamp purple from BELOW position)
Currently:

Let me try pressing SPACE from BELOW position with purple selected. This should stamp purple on the bottom region.
